notes.title: 📖 Final Quest Almost Ready – Update + Personal Note 📖
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/a66d264acb5bc9a931e7d2b4e6fcea967f902733.jpg"][/img][b]

Good news first:[/b]
All videos for the [b]4th and final quest[/b] of the upcoming [b]free content update[/b] are now complete!
All that’s left is rendering a few still frames and coding the last quest.[/p][p]As usual, I’ve included [b]sneak peeks from new scenes[/b] 👀

[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/7f0320defbabe7baf0fa746e22774eb4fbbde4db.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/280e7d9ea72e4c27f880dba43f8844aa9c1ac05c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/81293d760528bd98e7c4470172b4c5d65b89a244.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]

📝 [b]A Quick Personal Note:[/b][/p][p]The update took longer than I expected. I want to [b]apologize[/b] for the delay.[/p][p]Part of the reason was… me. I realized I’ve been procrastinating more than usual lately.
Maybe it’s fear—after seeing some recent censorship incidents, I started to worry my game might get taken down too.
Maybe it’s because the game is already out, and somewhere deep in my mind I gave myself permission to slow down.
I’m not entirely sure.[/p][p]Originally, I wanted to release a [b]Next Fest demo [/b]for a new game this October, but I’ve postponed that plan to the [b]winter nextfest [/b]instead.[/p][p]That said, I wasn’t completely idle.[/p][p]During this time, I’ve been planning out the [b]story arcs, characters, and structure for Game 2 and Game 3[/b] of the [i]Lustborne Chronicle[/i] series.

You’ll definitely see characters from [i]Memory of Lust[/i] again—and their stories will continue.
The narrative continuity between the games will be tight and satisfying. 💫[/p][p]I’m also in the early planning phase of a completely separate project set in the modern day... more on that later.[/p][hr][/hr][p]So, long story short:
[b]Thank you for your patience. I’m sorry for the delay. The free content update is coming very soon![/b][/p][p]❤️[/p]

notes.title: 🌹 Update Preview – "Gold, Gus and Roses" Quest Incoming! 🌹
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/069390c39d18b7b2e10274d66f63fc2c1d37deee.jpg"][/img]As part of the free content update, the [b]third new quest[/b] is currently in development!

Titled [b]"Gold, Guns and Roses,"[/b] this story unfolds in the bustling [b]market area[/b], where a mysterious prophecy promises fortune… if you're bold (and reckless) enough to chase it.
Expect themes of [b]desire, ambition, and temptation[/b]—all wrapped.[/p][p]The quest isn’t finished yet, but here are some [b]sneak peeks[/b] from scenes:
[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/510cb074ff5d27ea9581c9cef563de9f36ce1062.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/6195f1f429f6838ff3ec906c9314ce456f953232.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/2658876b6fe22effb1abfd335a4058d35f5d8f94.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]

🛠️ [b]Steam Policy Note:
[/b]
Due to recent changes, one [b]bath scene from the prologue[/b] has been removed.
That said, none of the remaining content includes incest or non-consensual elements, so we don’t expect further issues—but Steam is Steam, and things can always change.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support! 💛

As always, feel free to suggest scenes you'd like to see next![/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Release Date Announcement 🔥
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/a58498c727d16a801eb220e9ed775c45c4606ee7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/309f690b61783b3316baf483010d6296402179fc.png[/img][/url]

Welcome to the world of [u][b]Memory of Lust[/b][/u] — a darkly sensual visual novel where the boundaries between memory, desire, and identity blur into one unforgettable journey.

🗓️ The game officially launches on [b][u]June 16th[/u][/b], and it's packed with content:

✨ [u][b]8 fully-developed quest routes[/b][/u], each with unique characters, storylines, and emotionally charged moments.  
🎞️ Over [u][b]100 animated scenes[/b][/u] — carefully crafted to bring the story and its sensual encounters to life.  
🖼️ More than **[b][u]650 static CG scenes[/u][/b]**, detailing the world, characters, and dramatic turning points in rich visual storytelling.

🧠 The core narrative is now [u][b]complete[/b][/u], allowing you to uncover the [b][u]truth behind your memory loss[/u][/b], rediscover [b][u]who you really are[/u][/b], and unravel the secrets hidden within the mysterious town you've found yourself in.

But this is only the beginning.

🔜 In the [u][b]upcoming months[/b][/u], we’ll be adding [u][b]free updates[/b][/u] that include:
- New [b][u]side quests[/u][/b] and [b][u]optional scenes[/u][/b]
- Additional [u][b]story arcs[/b][/u]
- Fresh character interactions and world-expanding content

All updates will be [u][b]100% free[/b][/u] for all players — no paid DLCs, no cut content. Just more story, more passion, and more answers.

💖 Wishlist [u][b]Memory of Lust[/b][/u] now and get ready to begin your descent into mystery, memory, and desire on [u][b]June 16th[/b][/u].
